FieldNotes.Comments: X-Array at 0/90. N/S line shortened to avoid road. Conduit on lines. MAG cable ID: NMC39. Russian buckets used on all lines. Soil is compact sand and clay. Dense vegitation, site is in the middle of a pine logging forest. Animals in area, deer tracks spotted. Standing swamp 200m from east line, if water level rises it may flood site. NIMS above ground. Both NIMS and MAG double bagged.
